selected_evidence.summary: Established RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, SELinux enforcing, healthy SSH, no failed units, `/srv/drop` absent, and no pre-existing regular files under `/srv`.

selected_evidence.requirement: Configure `/srv/drop` as a shared writable sticky directory
selected_evidence.summary: Created `/srv/drop` as root:root with mode 1777 and the expected SELinux context.

selected_evidence.requirement: Users can write but cannot remove files owned by other users
selected_evidence.summary: Both `nobody` and `daemon` created files. Cross-owner deletion attempts failed with `Operation not permitted`, while each owner successfully removed its own files, before and after restart.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 2db46909-a020-4fda-b1db-2c3ead04c18a to 9d18dfc5-b0b6-419f-83a9-faeb69b900bc; SSH, directory metadata, checksummed marker data, and system health recovered.

All test files were removed. `/srv/drop` remains empty, root:root, mode 1777; SELinux is enforcing, relevant packages are unchanged, SSH is active, listeners are unchanged, and there are zero failed units.
